points.form: 申します / いたします / おります
points.formation: Earlier lexical forms; suitable お/ご + stem + いたす combines destination respect and listener deference. Not a universal prefix algorithm.
points.teachingChoice: Applicant’s own-side actions; never mark the respected interviewer’s acts as いたします.

points.form: 御社 / 貴社 / 弊社
points.formation: JASSO printed page34 and Mynavi distinguish spoken 御社 from written 貴社. Mynavi also identifies 弊社 as an external own-company reference; an applicant does not use it to mean the prospective employer. Agency supplies category distinctions rather than independent lexical proof for every prefix.
points.teachingChoice: Earlier source-checked company headwords are retrieved in their medium; do not claim an official N2 assignment.

points.form: 伺う / 拝見 / ご説明いただけますか
points.formation: 伺う can visit/hear/ask a respected destination; 拝見 is lexical own-side looking; receiving an explanation differs from offering one.
points.teachingChoice: Actor and question purpose determine the selected form; valid shorter requests are not rejected merely for style.

points.formation: A discourse strategy, not a suffix. JASSO printed48 distinguishes motivation/own strengths and59 follow-up on submitted experience; MHLW self-introduction links action/results/future use.
points.teachingChoice: Concrete map revision and repaired written weekday, not exaggerated achievement or a guarantee of hiring.

sourceCautions: JASSO and MHLW recommendations are not universal interview scoring rubrics. Only selected relevant sections are relied on.
